inv.desc_en: Commercial Premises for Sale - Premium Street-Level Area. Unique opportunity! We present this magnificent commercial space of 135 m² built, located in an unbeatable street-level area. It is a ground-floor unit with a versatile layout that will allow you to develop your business project without limitations. With 2 spacious rooms and 1 full bathroom, this space is perfect for setting up the business you have always wanted. The possibilities for use are practically unlimited. In addition to being ideal as a commercial space, you can also use it as a storage room or even as a garage, adapting it completely to your specific needs. Located in a strategic position, this space enjoys excellent visibility and accessibility. Its construction dates back to 1964, which gives it character and structural solidity. We have extensive opening hours so you can visit it without any obligation, adapting to your availability. Do not hesitate to contact us to arrange an appointment and discover all the potential that this exceptional commercial space offers. -.. . Call us, our commercial advisors will assist you during extended business hours. If you send us an email, include your phone number so we can contact you as soon as possible. This property is subject to price changes or withdrawal from the market without prior notice. The information in this advertisement in its entirety (photos, text, or any other content) is shown for informational and non-contractual purposes and is not binding, as the information is provided by third parties and may contain errors. The price does not include the following: real estate agency fees, ITP (Property Transfer Tax), and other expenses of the sale (Notary, Registry, and administrative agency fees). The objects and belongings in this advertisement are not included in the price; they are for informational and non-contractual purposes only.
